q: Which equation is balanced for hydrogen and oxygen?
Why is the first equation not balanced?
There are 2 O on the left but only 1 on the right.
Check the magnesium in the third equation. Is it balanced?
No: 1 Mg on the left, 2 on the right; it needs 2Mg.
Write the balanced equation and explain why you may not change H₂O to H₂O₂.
2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO. Changing small numbers makes a different substance (H₂O₂ is hydrogen peroxide); only big numbers in front may change.
